title: USP7 inhibition perturbs proteostasis and tumorigenesis in triple-negative breast cancer

comments: The discovery that USP7 stabilizes E3 ligases rather than their substrates is mechanistically insightful, though the TOPORS-BRCA1-A functional connection requires further validation.
